versions.summary: Adds the complete cell-owned three-file basics set: first-reader FSim flame-length-class terminology, the evidence-to-SHIP reasoning chain, and an exact reference for ten categorical state tables, value linkage, screening limitations, capabilities, and known-answer tests.
